summary: Retested Preview quick-print after click-driven menu fix. Print menu now opens deterministically, backend document generation remains healthy, but QuickPrintDialog invoice flow still stalls in loading state in UI (no preview/error resolution within wait window).

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking vehicle-print-invoice, dialog opens but does not resolve to quick-print-preview or quick-print-error; remains on loading state.

integration_issues.issue: Menu click behavior is fixed and deterministic, but frontend quick-print generation did not complete to preview/error state during retest.
UI login path intermittently shows fetch/network failure in browser run even though direct /api/auth/login succeeds (200).

action_items: Investigate QuickPrintDialog invoice generation lifecycle: ensure it transitions from loading to preview or explicit error in all cases.
Instrument/inspect frontend runtime around payloadBuilder + api.post('/documents/generate') path to catch unresolved promises or swallowed errors.
Re-verify diagnosis and visit-print UI paths after invoice loading-state fix.
Investigate intermittent UI login fetch failure in Preview despite healthy backend auth endpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: VehicleDetails click-driven print menu state (printMenuOpen) is now working; dropdown appears deterministically on click.
Backend quick-print generation is green (pytest 4/4): invoice/diagnosis HTML contains required workshop fields including ورشة عبدالله الكبير, 0553280100, 1131051365.
Frontend issue is now concentrated in QuickPrintDialog resolution state, not in backend document generation payload/response contract.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Retest used API-auth session injection because UI login was flaky in browser run. Vehicle print menu is fixed (deterministic open). Main blocker remains QuickPrintDialog invoice flow stuck in loading (no preview/error). Backend regression file test_iter263_quick_print_preview.py passes fully and confirms workshop fields in generated HTML.
rca of the issue: RCA: previous hover-menu instability appears fixed. Current failure moved downstream: QuickPrintDialog opens but invoice generation in UI does not resolve state (loading persists). Because backend /api/documents/generate passed in pytest with required workshop and vehicle/customer context, likely root cause is frontend async/state handling (payloadBuilder/generateHtml lifecycle, timing, or unresolved request handling) rather than backend document service.
